title.narrative: Operational and Human Resources Support to UNEP Living Indus Initiative

description.narrative: The Indus River Basin occupies an important role in Pakistan, sustaining its agriculture, ecosystems, and overall well-being. However, the basin faces significant environmental challenges, including water scarcity, pollution, and habitat degradation. This initiative necessitates substantial financial resources from diverse sources including UN agencies and Private Sector. UNOPS supports the project through contract management, travel administration and event management.
